import React, { useState, useEffect } from 'react'; import { FiBook, FiCalendar, FiMessageSquare, FiUsers, FiVideo, FiImage, FiPlus, FiArrowRight, FiActivity, FiRefreshCw, } from 'react-icons/fi'; import { useNavigate } from 'react-router-dom'; import api from '../../services/api'; import { useLanguage } from '../../contexts/LanguageContext'; const AdminDashboard = () => { const navigate = useNavigate(); // ========================================== // LANGUAGE // ========================================== const { t } = useLanguage(); // ========================================== // STATES // ========================================== const [stats, setStats] = useState({ courses: 0, events: 0, messages: 0, videos: 0, gallery: 0, users: 0, }); const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true); const [refreshing, setRefreshing] = useState(false); // ========================================== // LOAD STATS // ========================================== useEffect(() => { fetchStats(); }, []); // ========================================== // FETCH STATS // ========================================== const fetchStats = async (isRefresh = false) => { try { if (isRefresh) { setRefreshing(true); } else { setLoading(true); } const [ courses, events, messages, videos, gallery, ] = await Promise.all([ api.get('/api/courses/'), api.get('/api/events/'), api.get('/api/contact/'), api.get('/api/videos/'), api.get('/api/gallery/'), ]); setStats({ courses: Array.isArray(courses.data) ? courses.data.length : 0, events: Array.isArray(events.data) ? events.data.length : 0, messages: Array.isArray(messages.data) ? messages.data.length : 0, videos: Array.isArray(videos.data) ? videos.data.length : 0, gallery: Array.isArray(gallery.data) ? gallery.data.length : 0, users: 1, }); } catch (error) { console.error( 'Error fetching stats:', error ); } finally { setLoading(false); setRefreshing(false); } }; // ========================================== // STATS DATA // ========================================== const statsData = [ { title: t( 'dashboard.totalCourses' ), value: stats.courses, icon: FiBook, iconBg: 'bg-blue-50', iconColor: 'text-blue-900', borderColor: 'border-blue-200', description: t( 'dashboard.availableCourses' ), }, { title: t( 'dashboard.events' ), value: stats.events, icon: FiCalendar, iconBg: 'bg-blue-50', iconColor: 'text-blue-900', borderColor: 'border-blue-200', description: t( 'dashboard.schoolEvents' ), }, { title: t( 'dashboard.messages' ), value: stats.messages, icon: FiMessageSquare, iconBg: 'bg-red-50', iconColor: 'text-red-600', borderColor: 'border-red-100', description: t( 'dashboard.contactMessages' ), }, { title: t( 'dashboard.videos' ), value: stats.videos, icon: FiVideo, iconBg: 'bg-blue-50', iconColor: 'text-blue-900', borderColor: 'border-blue-200', description: t( 'dashboard.publishedVideos' ), }, { title: t( 'dashboard.galleryImages' ), value: stats.gallery, icon: FiImage, iconBg: 'bg-red-50', iconColor: 'text-red-600', borderColor: 'border-red-100', description: t( 'dashboard.galleryPhotos' ), }, { title: t( 'dashboard.adminUsers' ), value: stats.users, icon: FiUsers, iconBg: 'bg-blue-50', iconColor: 'text-blue-900', borderColor: 'border-blue-200', description: t( 'dashboard.systemAdministrators' ), }, ]; // ========================================== // QUICK ACTIONS // ========================================== const quickActions = [ { title: t( 'dashboard.addNewCourse' ), description: t( 'dashboard.createNewCourse' ), icon: FiBook, path: '/admin/courses', }, { title: t( 'dashboard.createNewEvent' ), description: t( 'dashboard.publishSchoolEvent' ), icon: FiCalendar, path: '/admin/events', }, { title: t( 'dashboard.uploadGalleryImage' ), description: t( 'dashboard.addPhotosGallery' ), icon: FiImage, path: '/admin/gallery', }, ];
